step1.description:
Join me to take a look at what SolidStart is shaping up to be. I will be going through a full tour of the framework to show you what it is, what you can do with it, and how it changes things.

[0:00:00] Intro

[0:56:30] "use server" in a Client Rendered App
[1:09:15] Code-Splitting & Hoisted Data Fetching
[1:25:00] FileRoutes 
[1:32:00] SSR
[1:41:00] The New Router, createAsync() & load()
[1:52:00] cache()
[1:59:30] action() & useSubmissions()
[2:06:30] Pre-Rendering & Progressive Enhancement
[2:22:00] .with() for Partial Application
[2:37:30] What Does SolidStart Actually Do?
[2:42:30] Throwing Redirects & Returning Errors
[2:49:00] Session Management & Other h3 Features 
[2:55:00] Server Functions vs. Serializing Functions
[3:00:00] Middleware
[3:05:00] Automatic Fine-Grained Updates
[3:13:00] What's Next? Islands? SCs? GET actions?
[3:22:45] Version Skew, Vercel, & Vendor Lock-In
[3:35:30] Marketing, Solid, & Community
[3:40:45] Server Waterfalls & The Edge
[3:54:00] Conclusion: SolidStart Beta 2 is Coming
[4:08:00] This Week in JavaScript: The State of Frameworks
[4:15:00] TWiJ: Solid News
[4:20:30] TWiJ: Astro 4.0
[4:28:00] TWiJ: Tanstack Router's Journey

[4:50:15] Q&A: New Benchmarks? Cross-Compatibility?
[4:55:15] TWiJ Lightning Round & Conclusion
